_description: Machine-readable dependency tiering for open-cowork. Tier 1 = LLM/model/agent core, Tier 2 = platform & integrations, Tier 3 = supporting utilities. Use this as input for future uplift research.
scope: runtime dependencies only (devDependencies excluded per user request)

tier_1_core.label: Core — LLM, model, agent runtime
tier_1_core.description: Direct impact on AI model communication and agent execution. Any breaking change or missed feature here directly blocks or unlocks end-user features. Monitor aggressively.

tier_2_platform.label: Platform — app shell, storage, channel integrations
tier_2_platform.description: Support significant end-user features (remote channels, persistence, UI shell, auto-update). Swappable but costly; new features here translate to visible product capability.

tier_3_supporting.label: Supporting — rendering, i18n, utilities
tier_3_supporting.description: Visible quality-of-life and rendering improvements, but broadly commodity libraries with stable APIs. Uplift when convenient or for security.

packages.name: @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent
packages.role: Core agent execution engine. createAgentSession, SessionManager, tool dispatch, streaming — drives agent-runner.ts (1514 lines). This is the heart of the app.
packages.risk_notes: Pre-1.0 (0.71.x) — breaking changes possible between minors. Shares monorepo with pi-ai; uplift both together. Uplifted 0.60→0.71 on 2026-05-01: required 5 code adaptations (TypeBox 1.x, ModelRegistry factory, appendSystemPrompt array, tools→customTools, event renames).

packages.name: @mariozechner/pi-ai
packages.role: Unified LLM API layer. Provider routing, model registry resolution, auth storage — resolves which SDK/endpoint to call for a given (provider, model) pair.
packages.risk_notes: Pre-1.0 — registry additions (new models, providers) are key release value. Must be version-locked with pi-coding-agent. Uplifted 0.60→0.71 on 2026-05-01.

packages.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
packages.role: MCP client + server. Powers MCPManager — stdio / SSE / StreamableHTTP transports for connecting external MCP servers and exposing their tools to the agent.
packages.risk_notes: Actively evolving protocol. New transport types and spec revisions land here; uplift early to ship new connector capabilities.

packages.name: @anthropic-ai/sdk
packages.role: Official Anthropic SDK. Used for API diagnostics and one-shot probes against Claude / Anthropic-compatible endpoints.
packages.risk_notes: Pre-1.0 but stable. Tracks new Claude model families and response formats; missing a release means missing new model support. Uplifted 0.39→0.92 on 2026-05-01 — no breaking changes for our usage surface.

packages.name: openai
packages.role: Official OpenAI SDK. Used for API diagnostics across all OpenAI-compatible providers (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, custom endpoints, DashScope, etc.).
packages.risk_notes: Ships new response formats (Responses API, structured outputs, tools) frequently. Breaking changes are clearly flagged in major versions.

packages.name: @google/genai
packages.role: Official Google Gemini SDK. Used in auth diagnostics (models.get probe) for Gemini and custom Gemini-protocol endpoints.
packages.risk_notes: New Gemini model families and preview APIs ship here. Major/minor bumps may rename client classes.

packages.name: electron-updater
packages.role: Auto-update mechanism for the packaged Electron app. Critical for shipping new features to installed users.
packages.risk_notes: Tied to electron-builder release cycle. Security updates (signature verification) matter here.

packages.name: electron-store
packages.role: Persistent user settings (API keys, profiles, provider presets, UI preferences). All configuration flows through this.
packages.risk_notes: v10 -> v11 was ESM-only breaking change. Monitor for migration utilities and encryption features.

packages.name: better-sqlite3
packages.role: Native SQLite binding — persistent storage for sessions, messages, memory, scheduled tasks. Whole persistence layer.
packages.risk_notes: Native module — requires electron rebuild on Electron version bump. Node/Electron ABI compatibility is the main concern.

packages.name: @larksuiteoapi/node-sdk
packages.role: Official Feishu/Lark SDK. Powers the Feishu remote channel (WebSocket long-connection + REST fallback, interactive cards, image upload).
packages.risk_notes: New event types and card schemas land here. Required for new Feishu bot capabilities.

packages.name: @slack/bolt
packages.role: Slack app framework — Socket Mode and webhook handling for the Slack remote channel.
packages.risk_notes: Declared as exact pin. New Slack platform features (AI assistants, canvases) surface here. Coordinate with @slack/web-api uplift.

packages.name: @slack/web-api
packages.role: Slack Web API client. Used alongside Bolt for direct API calls (auth.test, message posting, user lookup).
packages.risk_notes: Exact pin. Must be compatible with @slack/bolt major.

packages.name: ngrok
packages.role: Tunnel manager — exposes the local remote gateway to the internet so Slack/Feishu webhooks can reach it.
packages.risk_notes: Community wrapper on a pre-release. Official ngrok v2 JS API is a potential swap target.

packages.name: ws
packages.role: WebSocket server for the Remote Gateway — how external web clients connect to the agent runtime.
packages.risk_notes: Security-sensitive. Track CVEs and DoS fixes closely.

packages.name: chokidar
packages.role: File watcher for the Skills hot-reload system. Users see skill changes live without restart — core to the Skills feature.
packages.risk_notes: v4 removed fsevents dep (breaking). Mostly stable now.

packages.name: react
packages.role: Entire renderer UI framework.
packages.risk_notes: React 19 is released — major upgrade with Actions, use() hook, asset loading. Must be coordinated with react-dom.

packages.name: react-dom
packages.role: React DOM renderer — must match react major.
packages.risk_notes: Lock-step with react.

packages.name: zustand
packages.role: Client-side state management (sessions, UI state, config view models).
packages.risk_notes: v5 major done — API stable.

packages.name: archiver
packages.role: Zip/tar generation. Used for packaging artifacts, skills exports, diagnostic bundles.
packages.risk_notes: Stable mature lib.

packages.name: dotenv
packages.role: Environment variable loading for the main process.
packages.risk_notes: Mature. Major version jumps (16->17) tighten parsing.

packages.name: react-markdown
packages.role: Renders model output as Markdown in chat. Part of user-visible message rendering.
packages.risk_notes: Coordinates with remark-gfm / remark-math / rehype-katex / rehype-sanitize versions.

packages.name: remark-gfm
packages.role: GitHub Flavored Markdown support (tables, task lists, strikethrough) for react-markdown.
packages.risk_notes: Pair with react-markdown major.

packages.name: remark-math
packages.role: Parses math blocks in markdown for KaTeX rendering.
packages.risk_notes: Pair with rehype-katex.

packages.name: rehype-katex
packages.role: Converts remark-math AST nodes into rendered KaTeX HTML.
packages.risk_notes: Pair with katex major.

packages.name: rehype-sanitize
packages.role: HTML sanitization on model-generated markdown — security boundary against XSS from LLM output.
packages.risk_notes: Security-relevant despite Tier 3. Monitor for CVE advisories even if not actively tracking features.

packages.name: katex
packages.role: Math typesetting engine used by rehype-katex.
packages.risk_notes: Stable 0.16.x line. Major bump to 1.0 not yet released.

packages.name: highlight.js
packages.role: Syntax highlighting for code blocks in rendered markdown.
packages.risk_notes: New language grammars are the main uplift value.

packages.name: i18next
packages.role: Translation engine for EN/ZH UI localization.
packages.risk_notes: Major versions bump infrequently. Pair with react-i18next.

packages.name: react-i18next
packages.role: React bindings for i18next — hooks and components.
packages.risk_notes: Pair with i18next major.

packages.name: i18next-browser-languagedetector
packages.role: Auto-detects user language from navigator/localStorage.
packages.risk_notes: Very stable.

packages.name: lucide-react
packages.role: Icon library — all UI iconography.
packages.risk_notes: Frequent minor releases add new icons. 0.x versioning.

packages.name: glob
packages.role: Filesystem globbing utility.
packages.risk_notes: v11 is released. Minor breaking changes around default exports.

packages.name: typebox
packages.role: TypeBox schema library (successor to @sinclair/typebox). Used in agent-runner.ts to wrap MCP tool JSON Schemas as TypeBox TSchema for pi-coding-agent ToolDefinition.
packages.risk_notes: Added as direct dep during pi-* 0.60→0.71 uplift (TypeBox 1.x migration). Same author as @sinclair/typebox.

packages.name: uuid
packages.role: UUID v4 generation for session/message/artifact IDs.
packages.risk_notes: Boring commodity util. v11 already adopted.
